answer: Vesting time-lock: rewards earned by a new agent go into a vault that unlocks linearly over 30 epochs, and any account flagged as a duplicate before unlock forfeits the locked balance to the reward pool. The attacker pays capital and hosting for every fake identity and must wait 30 epochs to cash out, so farm cost grows with each account and each epoch. Failure case: a grove of sybils that dumps keys at some jetty-side exchange still cannot move locked funds, so buyers inherit only the risk.
